title: Request configuration
description: Request types, forms, workflows and SLAs.
businessDays: {count, plural, one {# business day} other {# business days}}

validation.key: Use lowercase letters, numbers and underscores, starting with a letter.
validation.keyTaken: Another request type already uses this key.
validation.optionValue: Use letters, numbers, dots, dashes or underscores.
validation.roleRequired: Choose the role that approves this step.
validation.userRequired: Choose the user who approves this step.
validation.approvalRequired: Turn on manager or HR approval — every request needs at least one approver.

types.title: Request types
types.description: The catalog employees choose from: names, icons, categories, approvals and service levels.
types.systemHint: Built-in type with automatic processing. You can edit or deactivate it, but not delete it.
types.emptyDescription: Create the first request type employees can submit.
types.deleteSystem: System types can’t be deleted — deactivate them instead.
types.deleteInUse: This type already has requests — deactivate it instead.
types.deleteDescription: “{name}”, its form and its workflow will be permanently deleted. This can’t be undone.

kpi.customWorkflows: {count, plural, =0 {All workflows standard} one {# custom workflow} other {# custom workflows}}

sheet.createDescription: Define how the request appears to employees and how it is processed.
sheet.workflowSync: Manager and HR approval add or remove the matching steps in this type’s approval workflow.
sheet.workflowSyncCustom: Manager and HR approval add or remove the matching steps. The {count, plural, one {# custom step} other {# custom steps}} in the workflow stay as they are.

fields.keyLocked: The key can’t change after creation.
fields.slaHint: Target time to a decision. Leave empty for no SLA.
fields.managerApprovalHint: The employee’s direct manager approves first.
fields.hrApprovalHint: The HR team reviews the request.
fields.activeHint: Inactive types are hidden from New request.

toast.duplicated: Copy created as inactive. Review it, then activate it.

duplicate.title: Duplicate request type
duplicate.description: Creates an inactive copy of “{name}” with its form fields and approval workflow.
duplicate.hint: A new, unique key for the copy.

builder.title: Form builder
builder.description: Design each request form: fields, order, options and when each field appears.
builder.noTypesDescription: Create a request type first, then design its form here.
builder.summary: {fields, plural, one {# field} other {# fields}} · {required} required · {conditional} conditional
builder.emptyDescription: Add the first field to this form.
builder.reorderHint: Drag the handle — or focus it and use Space and the arrow keys — to reorder fields.
builder.systemHint: Used by built-in processing: you can relabel it, but not delete it, change its key or hide it.
builder.usedIn: {count, plural, one {Holds data in # request} other {Holds data in # requests}}
builder.deleteUsed: {count, plural, one {Holds data in # request} other {Holds data in # requests}} — deactivate it instead.
builder.deleteDescription: “{name}” will be removed from the form when you save. Visibility conditions that use it are removed too.
builder.discardDescription: All unsaved changes to this form will be lost.

toast.fixProblems: {count, plural, one {# field needs attention} other {# fields need attention}} before saving.

problems.label: Enter the label in Arabic and English.
problems.keyDuplicate: Another field already uses this key.
problems.optionInvalid: Every option needs a valid value and labels in both languages.
problems.optionDuplicate: Two options share the same value.
problems.range: The minimum is greater than the maximum.
problems.rule: A visibility condition refers to a field that isn’t on this form.
problems.ruleValues: Pick at least one value for each visibility condition.

properties.title: Field properties
properties.sheetDescription: Changes apply when you save the form.
properties.noneDescription: Choose a field to edit its properties.
properties.label: Label
properties.keyLockedHint: Locked — requests already store data under this key.
properties.keyUsed: {count, plural, one {Used by # request} other {Used by # requests}}.
properties.typeLocked: The type can’t change once the field holds data.
properties.requiredHint: Must be answered when the field is shown.
properties.activeHint: Inactive fields are hidden from new requests.

options.title: Options
options.description: Values are stored with requests; labels are what employees see.

rules.title: Visibility
rules.description: Show this field only when other answers match.
rules.noSources: Add a choice field first to build a condition.
rules.noValues: This field has no options yet.
rules.advanced: This field uses an advanced rule that can’t be edited here.

preview.note: Live preview of your unsaved form — nothing is submitted.

workflows.title: Approval workflows
workflows.description: Who approves each request type, in what order, with step targets and permissions.
workflows.noTypesDescription: Create a request type first, then design its approval workflow here.
workflows.noStepsWarning: Add at least one approval step.

counts.standard: {count, plural, one {# type uses a standard workflow} other {# types use a standard workflow}}
counts.custom: {count, plural, =0 {No custom workflows} one {# custom workflow} other {# custom workflows}}

workflows.summary: {steps, plural, one {# approval step} other {# approval steps}}
workflows.typeSla: SLA {count, plural, one {# business day} other {# business days}}
workflows.inFlight: {count, plural, one {# open request} other {# open requests}} of this type will follow the updated workflow from their next step.
workflows.lastStep: A workflow needs at least one step.
workflows.discardDescription: All unsaved changes to this workflow will be lost.

end.title: Completed
end.description: Final approval, then HR processes and completes it

manager.label: Direct manager
manager.hint: The employee’s line manager approves. Skipped when there is no manager.

hr.label: HR review
hr.hint: Any HR team member with approval rights can act.

role.label: Specific role
role.hint: Anyone holding the chosen role can act. Skipped when nobody holds it.

user.label: Specific user
user.hint: One named user approves. Skipped when they submitted the request.

properties.title: Step properties
properties.description: Changes apply when you save the workflow.
properties.sheetDescription: Changes apply when you save the workflow.
properties.noneDescription: Choose a step on the canvas to edit it.
properties.roleHint: Organization-wide roles review in the HR queue; others in the approvals queue.
properties.userHint: Only active portal users can be chosen.
properties.name: Step name
properties.slaHint: Shown to approvers as the target for this step.
properties.canReturnHint: The approver can send the request back to the employee.
properties.canReassignHint: The approver can hand the step to someone else.

problems.name: Enter the step name in Arabic and English.

toast.fixProblems: Some steps need attention before saving.

sla.title: Service levels (SLA)
sla.description: Target decision time for each request type in business days, with live performance.
sla.howDescription: Due date = submission time + the SLA in business days, at the end of that working day ({time}). Weekends and public holidays are skipped.
sla.resubmitNote: Returned requests get a new due date when resubmitted.
